title: PreferenceAtom
description: A single mined workflow preference extracted from session transcripts.

trigger.description: Condition or context that activates this preference.

workflow_step.description: Named phase or action in the workflow where preference applies.

decision_rule.description: Concise actionable rule extracted from the transcript signal.

quality_bar.description: Observable criterion that satisfies this preference.

stop_condition.description: When this preference no longer applies or should be overridden.

evidence_refs.description: Source references (file paths, IDs) — raw excerpts are NOT stored here.

confidence.description: Signal strength for this preference atom.

artifact_choice.description: Suggested artifact type if this atom is promoted to a SelfSteer proposal.
